kadry.title: Filmowy portret w zamyśleniu · światłocień
kadry.prompt:
Wersja poprawiona: jedna spójna wersja czarno-biała, zachowanie fryzury i wieku ze zdjęcia, konkretny gest dłoni oraz kadr 9:16.

Pełny prompt:

IDENTITY PRESERVATION — HIGHEST PRIORITY
Use the uploaded photograph as the sole identity reference for the adult woman. Create a completely new photorealistic artistic fashion portrait of the same recognizable person.

Preserve her natural facial structure and proportions, apparent age, skin tone, natural asymmetry, forehead, temples, eye shape and spacing, eyelids, eyebrows, nose, lips, cheekbones, jawline, chin, ears, neck, shoulders and natural body build. Retain realistic pores, fine lines, freckles, moles and other visible identifying details.

Preserve the actual hair color, haircut, length, hairline, density, texture, parting and natural volume shown in the reference. The hair may move subtly and a few existing strands may frame the face, but do not recolor, lengthen, shorten, curl, straighten or reinterpret it.

The reference photograph defines identity and physical appearance only. Do not recreate its selfie framing, sunglasses, clothing, pose, expression, camera angle, lighting, background or environment.

Do not de-age, beautify, reshape, slim or replace the woman. Do not enlarge her eyes or lips, reshape her nose, impose artificial symmetry or create a generic model face.

CONCEPT
An elegant, intimate cinematic portrait of the same woman caught in a quiet private moment of thought. She appears calm, intelligent, self-assured and slightly mysterious. The image should feel observed rather than deliberately posed.

COMPOSITION
Vertical 9:16 editorial portrait, framed from approximately mid-torso to slightly above the hair. Place the woman a little to camera-right, leaving restrained dark negative space on camera-left.

Her torso is turned subtly toward frame-right while her face turns gently toward the light on frame-left. Her head is inclined only slightly downward and to the side. Keep the face near a three-quarter view so both eyes remain naturally placed and her identity stays clear.

Use an elegant elongated composition that flatters the natural neck and shoulder line without stretching the body or changing proportions. Avoid centered passport-style framing.

POSE
Keep the posture relaxed and believable. Let the shoulder nearer the camera sit slightly lower. One arm rests naturally along the body. The other forearm crosses gently in front of the torso, and that hand rests lightly on the opposite upper arm just above the elbow.

Show only the hand anatomy naturally allowed by the crop. Keep one hand, five correctly formed fingers, a connected wrist and relaxed joints. Do not place the hand on the face or neck.

EXPRESSION
Eyes lowered slightly and directed outside the frame toward the light. Relaxed forehead and jaw, natural closed lips and no direct camera contact. The mood is thoughtful and quietly confident, without a smile, sadness or theatrical emotion.

WARDROBE
Replace the original clothing with a refined black or deep-charcoal long-sleeved ribbed knit top. Use a soft asymmetric boat neckline that reveals the natural collarbone line without becoming low-cut. The garment follows her real silhouette with a relaxed tailored fit.

No sunglasses, wristwatch, necklace, earrings, rings, logos or patterns. Add only one very delicate minimalist bracelet on the wrist of the hand resting on the opposite arm.

LIGHTING
Use cinematic chiaroscuro inspired by European fashion photography. A large soft directional light comes from high frame-left and gently models the forehead, nearer eye, cheekbone, nose, lips and neck. The opposite side falls gradually into rich shadow.

Use minimal reflected fill only to retain natural facial detail. Add a very subtle background gradient behind the darkest hair edge for separation. Keep realistic skin texture, controlled highlights and smooth tonal transitions. No beauty lighting, plastic skin or heavy retouching.

BACKGROUND AND COLOR
Use a featureless deep-charcoal to near-black studio background with no furniture, objects or recognizable location.

Render the image exclusively in sophisticated cinematic black and white: rich blacks, soft silver highlights and natural mid-gray skin tones. No color tint or color accents.

CAMERA
Professional full-frame fashion photography with a 105mm portrait lens at approximately f/4. Keep both eyes and the main facial planes sharply resolved, with gentle optical falloff toward the rear shoulder and background. Use natural compressed perspective and realistic lens rendering.

STYLE AND FINISH
High-end European fashion editorial combined with intimate fine-art portrait photography. Gallery-quality monochrome image, subtle analog film grain, refined tonal range, cinematic restraint and authentic emotional presence.

The woman must remain recognizably herself. Preserve her age, natural facial proportions, hair and real body shape while presenting her with elegant lighting and composition.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
different person, generic model face, identity drift, face swap, de-aging, beautified face, altered facial proportions, artificial symmetry, enlarged eyes, reshaped nose, enlarged or altered lips, changed skin tone, different hairstyle, recolored hair, hair extensions, changed body proportions, slimmed body, sunglasses, wristwatch, large jewelry, multiple bracelets, selfie appearance, original background, original clothing, direct recreation of reference pose, direct camera stare, smile, theatrical sadness, exaggerated makeup, beauty filter, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, extra fingers, malformed hands, extra hands, extra limbs, disconnected wrist, stiff pose, HDR, oversharpening, fantasy elements, color tint, text, logo, watermark, obvious AI artifacts.

ASPECT RATIO: 9:16.

kadry.title: THE HYPNOTIC GAZE
kadry.description: Oryginalny niemiecki master-prompt dostarczony 2026-11-03; pełne tłumaczenie angielskie. Miniatura wymaga umieszczenia na stronie.
kadry.tags: one eye, hypnotic gaze, monochrome, fine art
kadry.prompt:
AGATOTO 1 — THE HYPNOTIC GAZE
MASTER PROMPT | Black & White Fine Art Portrait

Create an exceptionally intense, absolutely photorealistic black-and-white fine-art portrait using my uploaded original photographs.

IDENTITY — ABSOLUTE PRIORITY
Preserve my actual facial identity as faithfully as possible. Eye shape, natural eye color, eyebrows, nose, lip shape and volume, facial proportions, skin texture, age, and individual identifying features such as piercings, moles, or freckles must remain unchanged. No beautification, rejuvenation, or artificial facial symmetry.

FRAMING & COMPOSITION
Extremely tight, asymmetrical vertical portrait crop in a 4:5 aspect ratio. Only one half of the face is visible; the other half lies outside the frame. The visible eye is positioned in the upper-left area of the image. The nose and mouth are partially cut off by the left edge of the frame. The right half of the image shows a calm, dark-gray, blurred background.

THE GAZE — HYPNOTIC & CAPTIVATING
Direct, intense eye contact with the camera. The eyelids are very slightly lowered; the gaze is mysterious, self-assured, sensual, and subtly challenging. Preserve the natural eye shape.

The iris retains its actual brightness and color, rendered in authentic grayscale values. A small, clear window-light catchlight creates a fascinating sparkle. Subtle, slightly smudged dark eyeliner enhances the depth of the gaze.

MOUTH & EXPRESSION
The lips are naturally relaxed and parted by only a few millimeters. Preserve the original lip shape and natural volume completely. No pout, no artificially fuller lips, no visible tongue. The expression is calm, serious, and subtly sensual.

HAIR & WIND
Loosely pinned-up, voluminous messy bun with naturally falling strands. A gentle but clearly visible breeze blows from right to left. Several individual strands of varying lengths move dynamically in soft curves across the forehead, eye area, cheek, and mouth. Some strands are sharp; others have slight motion blur. The visible eye remains mostly unobstructed and recognizable. No artificially arranged hair.

CLOTHING
A simple white high-neck top with no patterns or lettering, partly visible along the bottom edge of the frame.

LIGHTING & PHOTOGRAPHY
Soft side window light from the front-left. Gentle shadows, natural contrast, nuanced grayscale gradations, and a subtle analog film look.

The photographic feel of a full-frame camera with an 85 mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, and natural lens softness. The visible eye is in precise focus.

Authentic skin with real pores, fine lines, and individual characteristics. No invented skin details, beauty retouching, oversharpened texture, HDR, or artificial AI sheen.

FINAL PRIORITY
Exact facial identity from the uploaded personal reference photographs. Hypnotic direct eye contact, authentic dark iris tones where applicable, subtle natural catchlight, slightly parted natural lips, windblown individual hair strands moving from right to left, extreme asymmetrical half-face crop, and soft cinematic black-and-white photography.

kadry.prompt:
Create an extremely realistic, artistic black-and-white portrait in dramatic low-key photography, based on the uploaded reference photograph.

IDENTITY PRESERVATION — HIGHEST PRIORITY
The person depicted must remain clearly recognizable as the individual shown in the uploaded reference photograph. Preserve their actual eye shape, natural eye color translated into corresponding grayscale tones, eye spacing, eyebrows, eyelashes, nose shape, facial contours, and all distinctive individual characteristics. Do not alter the person's identity or apply artificial beautification.

IMAGE COMPOSITION
An extremely tight, intimate close-up focusing on both eyes, eyebrows, and the upper portion of the nose. The face is turned slightly to the side, with a dreamy, intense gaze directed upward and to the right. Both eyes are exceptionally sharp, featuring natural reflections of light in the pupils. Fine, clearly defined eyelashes and highly detailed eyebrows. Visible, natural skin texture with delicate pores. The lower part of the face gradually disappears into deep black shadows. The hair and background blend almost completely into the darkness.

LIGHTING AND ATMOSPHERE
Dramatic yet soft studio lighting coming from the upper left side. Subtle highlights illuminate the forehead, eye area, cheeks, and bridge of the nose. Extremely deep blacks, brilliant silver-gray highlights, and finely graduated grayscale tones. An expressive, mysterious, elegant, and emotionally captivating atmosphere.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
Fine-art beauty photography, monochrome, high contrast, low-key lighting, macro portraiture, 85mm portrait lens, professional studio quality, ultra-realistic skin details, natural facial anatomy, exceptionally sharp iris structures, and high-quality black-and-white photographic processing.

FORMAT
Vertical portrait, 4:5 aspect ratio. The eye area is centered in the composition, with generous deep-black negative space occupying the lower portion of the image.

FINAL RESULT
An expressive, mysterious, almost entirely black fine-art portrait in which the person's real eyes and distinctive facial features, faithfully preserved from the uploaded reference photograph, emerge dramatically from the darkness.
